title: Why Do Ancient Traditions Tell Similar Stories? A Comparative Cultural-Evolution Study of Mythic Motifs, Inheritance, Diffusion, Ecology, and Convergence
domain: comparative mythology / folklore / cultural evolution / historical anthropology / computational humanities
summary: A multi-method cross-cultural study of recurrent mythic motifs that separates shared ancestry, horizontal diffusion, ecological convergence and cognitive/social convergence using auditable motif coding, temporal overlap, spatial/contact networks, phylogenetic comparative methods, dyadic models, process tracing and optional QCA.
